name: Kasimir Velikov

source.note: Curse of Strahd appendix block (2016) in the 2024 layout: a wizard (the book's mage with dusk-elf traits), not a warlock. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. His Hit Points and challenge rating especially need the book. AC assumes Mage Armor is up; Fire Bolt runs as an attack; spell slots are listed per spell.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed; magic can't put him to sleep.
traits.text: Kasimir has Advantage on saving throws against the Charmed condition, and magic can't put him to sleep.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.summary: Stabs with a dagger, or throws it up to 60 ft.
actions.text: Melee or ranged attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Bolt
actions.summary: Casts Fire Bolt up to 120 ft; loose flammable objects catch alight.
actions.text: Ranged spell attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) Fire damage. A flammable object that nobody is wearing or carrying catches fire.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: A 9th-level wizard (Int, DC 14, +6): Magic Missile, Shield, Counterspell, Fireball, Ice Storm, Cone of Cold.
actions.text: Kasimir casts spells as a 9th-level wizard, using Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Cantrips (at will): Fire Bolt, Light, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation. 1st level (4 slots): Detect Magic, Mage Armor, Magic Missile, Shield. 2nd level (3 slots): Misty Step, Suggestion. 3rd level (3 slots): Counterspell, Fireball, Fly. 4th level (3 slots): Greater Invisibility, Ice Storm. 5th level (1 slot): Cone of Cold.

summary: A grave dusk elf wizard: Magic Missile and Fire Bolt from a distance, Shield and Counterspell to stay standing.
